top_signals.title: Zelenskyy warns Ukraine is 'not real estate' as experts say a Russia peace deal remains elusive
top_signals.summary: President Zelenskyy warned Tuesday that his country "was not real estate," as a second and final day of U.S.-brokered peace talks got underway.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
top_signals.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Investors pivot to defensive stocks as markets enter a ‘state of alert’
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks have lost momentum while defensive sectors gain ground, as investors reassess risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
